assets.prompt: Create one WIDE landscape 3:2 modular LANDSCAPED PRECINCT BACKDROP for a handcrafted illustrated theme-park map. Use attached image only to match refined fine navy ink lines, cream stone, cyan, sage, ochre restrained screenprinted paper grain, isometric three-quarter architectural travel journal style. True transparent surrounding background. The composition is a shallow open horseshoe courtyard: decorative scenery around REAR and SIDES, broad empty cream stone clearing in the CENTER/FRONT for a separately layered main attraction icon and UI label. Center must stay empty and calm, no central building. Fine understated low peripheral structures with a few trees. Footprint irregular organically rounded, not rectangular tile, no thick toy pedestal. No text, numbers, UI, frames, characters, no glossy plastic, no candy colors. Keep every element inside image margin and ground-level elements visually connected. The backdrop will be small and secondary to a main illustration. Theme TRAVEL DEPARTURE GARDEN. Rear left a slender navy departure clock with cream circular face, rear right three cypress trees and a compact blue globe sculpture on a low stone plinth. Low ivory curved balustrade, cyan ceramic compass tiles at front edge, two tiny travel trunks and hydrangea beds at side corners. Gentle maritime blue and sage. Do not include an airplane or castle. Keep the central 55% clear cream paved ground.
